integrationPolicy: Preserve six physically independent app roots. InkDOS 2.0.12 makes the Home bridge optional through each app's own frame module: Home launches with suite=1, while direct or extracted launches hide the Home action and remove its active href without requiring a shared suite runtime. EPUB is physically reorganized so existing package I/O, engine, state, view and UI responsibilities live in app-private directories without intentionally changing reader algorithms. Release validation must prove isolated entry-resource resolution, absence of cross-app/shared-runtime references, valid offline APP_SHELL paths and the required EPUB modular layout. Existing appearance, empty-state, single-delivery Save and PDF frame contracts remain intact.
